metadata.description: Edit writing like a professional editor; the author writes every word

plugins.name: editwright
plugins.description: Edit writing like a professional editor without rewriting the author: editorial letters, developmental notes, line, copy and proofreading suggestions with IDs and quoted anchors, script coverage and nonfiction fact-check flags. The author's file is never modified, a provenance ledger counts every AI-written word, and only the suggestions the author accepts are applied, to a copy. Standard-library Python CLI for intake, word-safe cleanup, counts, apply and a tracked-changes .docx. Evergreen.
